newsitem.title: USA: Bristol-Myers seeks cheaper energy source.
newsitem.headline: Bristol-Myers seeks cheaper energy source.

text.p: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co said Wednesday it has submitted a petition to the New Jersey Board of Public Utilities seeking approval for the company to obtain its electrical energy from a competitive source.
Bristol-Meyers Squibb said it is wants to establish and participate in a pilot project allowing its eight New Jersey facilities to obtain electricity from a supplier outside the current service base.
The company said the cost for electricity in New Jersey has exceeded by more than 50 percent the company's costs at other locations in the United States despite energy-saving efforts.
The company is hoping to greatly reduce its energy costs through the pilot project.
Bristol-Myers New Jersey facilities are now served by Public Service Enterprise Group Inc's Publlic Service Electric & Gas Co subsidiary.
